hoaxes.title: Claude Duet will phone your manager each morning to read out your daily briefing
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Claude Duet sends morning briefings in its own app and asks before acting; it opened a US waitlist.

hoaxes.title: Netflix will stream The Super Mario Galaxy Movie with a built-in kart race between scenes
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The film simply streams on Netflix in the US from November 30, after its Peacock run.

hoaxes.title: Modern Warfare 4 adds a bonus campaign mission on a tropical resort island, only on Switch 2
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23 on Switch 2 and other consoles; its campaign spans Korea, New York, Paris and Mumbai.

hoaxes.title: Apple will sell a $299 motorised stand that folds and unfolds the iPhone Duo on a timer
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The iPhone Duo goes on sale October 23 from $1,999, with limited walk-in stock in Apple Stores.
